title: Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ Pineapple Ice 10ml E-Liquid
description: Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ Pineapple Ice delivers the bright, tangy-sweet flavour of ripe Pineapple, perfectly complemented by a crisp, cooling exhale. The juicy tropical notes burst through on the inhale, offering a bold and refreshing fruit experience, while the icy finish leaves a lingering chill for a perfectly balanced vape. Formulated for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, this nicotine salt e-liquid provides fast-acting nicotine satisfaction with a consistently smooth throat hit. The 50/50 VG/PG ratio enhances flavour clarity while keeping vapour production discreet, making it an excellent choice for pod kits and vape starter kits. Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ e-liquids offer a cost-effective and sustainable alternative to single-use disposable vapes, allowing you to enjoy familiar and satisfying flavours in a refillable format. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, each bottle features a childproof cap and an easy-fill nozzle for convenience.
